turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
Yes. You have a 10-minute window after placing the order to make final edits or cancel it through the View or Edit Your Order link in your confirmation email.

After that, cancellation depends on the order’s processing status. If you’d like me to check your order, please send the order number here.

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail: Unfortunately, once an order is placed, we’re unable to add, remove, or swap items. You can check the View or Edit Your Order link in your confirmation email, as final edits may be available within 10 minutes of placing the order.

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
If you mean adding, removing, or swapping an item, no. Once the order has shipped, it can’t be changed by MESHKI.

If you mean the shipping address, the order can’t be updated after shipment either. For StarTrack deliveries, you can use the carrier’s tracking tools to request a redirection or hold for pickup.
